description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Securities and Exchange Commission of Sri Lanka Act, No. 19 of 2021 Regulation under Section 155 (1)
reasoning: This gazette contains a regulation issued under the Securities and Exchange Commission of Sri Lanka Act, specifying rates of cess (tax) on various securities transactions.
